G4905.definition: συν-έρχομαι; 1. (cl.) to come together, assemble: Mrk.3:20 14:53, T, WH, txt., Act.1:6 2:6 10:27 16:13 19:32 21:22 22:30 28:17, 1Co.14:26; before εἰς, with accusative loc., Act.5:16; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, 1Co.11:20 14:23; with dative of person(s), Mrk.14:53, WH, mg., R (πρὸς αὐτόν, see Field, Notes, 40), Jhn.11:33; ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ, 1Co.11:18; ἐνθάδε, Act.25:17; Mrk.6:33, WH, mg. (cf. WH, Intr., 95 ff.); ὅπου, Jhn.18:20; with…

G4982.definition: Bl., §3, 1-3),; to save from peril, injury or suffering: Mat.8:25, Mrk.13:20, Luk.23:35, al.; τ. ψυχήν, Mat.16:25, al.; before ἐκ, Jhn.12:27, Heb.5:7, Ju 5; of healing, restoring to health: Mat.9:22, Mrk.5:34, al. In NT, esp. of salvation from spiritual disease and death, in which sense it is "spoken of in Scripture as either (1) past, (2) present, or (3) future, according as redemption, grace, or glory is the point…

G4970.definition: very, very much, exceedingly: with verbs, Mat.17:6, 23 18:31 19:25 26:22 27:54, Act.6:7; with adjectives, Mat.2:10, Mrk.16:4, Luk.18:23, Rev.16:21.†; (AS)

G4912.definition: συν-έχω; 1. to hold together (τ. συνέχον τ. πάντα, Wis.1:7): of closing the ears, Act.7:57 (τ. στόμα, Isa.52:15); to hem in, press on every side: Luk.8:45 19:43. ; 2. to hold fast; (a) of a prisoner, to hold in charge (Luc.; cf. exx. in Deiss., BS, 160; MM, xxiv): Luk.22:63; (b) to constrain: 2Co.5:14; pass., Luk.12:50, Act.18:5 (τ. λόγῳ; cf. Field, Notes, 128), Php.1:23; in pass., of ills, to be seized or afflicted…

G4983.definition: a body. ; 1. Prop., of the human body, ; (a) as always in Hom. (opposite to δέμας), of the dead body: Mat.27:58, 59 Mrk.15:43, al.; (b) of the living body: Luk.11:34, 1Co.6:13, al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, Heb.13:3; as the instrument of the soul, τὰ διὰ τοῦ σ., 2Co.5:10; opposite to πνεῦμα, Rom.8:10, 1Co.5:3 7:4, Jas.2:26; to ψυχή, Mat.6:25 10:28, Luk.12:22 (cf. Wis.1:1, al.); to τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ., 1Th.5:23; σ. ψυχικόν, opposite…

G4978.definition: (σχίζω), ; a rent (Arist., al.): Mat.9:16, Mrk.2:21. Metaphorical, a dissension, division: Jhn.7:43 9:16 10:19, 1Co.1:10 11:18 12:25.†; SYN.: see: αἵρεσις (AS)

G4933.definition: συν-τηρέω, -ῶ; "perfective" of τηρέω (see M, Pr., 113, 116), ; to preserve, keep safe, keep close: with accusative of person(s), Mrk.6:20; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.9:17; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Luk.2:19 (Arist. and later writers; cf. MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4908.definition: (συνίημι),  ; intelligent, sagacious, understanding: Mat.11:25, Luk.10:21, Act.13:7, 1Co.1:19" (LXX) .†; (AS)

G4937.definition: συν-τρίβω; to shatter, break in pieces: Mat.12:20 (LXX), Mrk.5:4 14:3, Jhn.19:36" (LXX), Rev.2:27; of persons and parts of the body, to break, crush, bruise: Luk.9:39; figuratively, Rom.16:20.†; (AS)

G4980.definition: (σχολή),  ; to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in: 1Co.7:5; of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, Mat.12:44, Luk.11:25 (T , R, om.).†; (AS)

G4920.definition: συν-ίημι and συνίω (see Bl., § 23, 7),; 1. to bring or set together. ; 2. Metaphorical, to perceive, understand: Mat.13:13-15 (LXX), Mat.13:19 15:10, Mrk.4:9 (WH, mg.), Mrk.4:12 7:14 8:17, 21 Luk.8:10, Act.7:25 28:26-27, Rom.15:21" (LXX), 2Co.10:12; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:23, 51, Luk.2:50 18:34 24:45; before ὅτι, Mat.16:12 17:13; before quæst. indir., Eph.5:17; ἐπὶ τ. ἄρτοις, Mrk.6:52; as subst., συνίων…

G4930.definition: (συντελέω),  ; 1. in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.). ; 2. In late writers (Polyb., al.), consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων (cf. Dan LXX TH Dan.12:13, al.), Mat.13:39-40, 49 24:3 28:20, Heb.9:26.†; (AS)

G4962.definition: συ-στέφω; 1. to twist together: with accusative of thing(s), Act.28:3. ; 2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: Mat.17:22 (WH, R, mg.).†; (AS)

G4929.definition: συν-τάσσω; to prescribe, ordain, arrange: with dative of person(s), Mat.21:6 26:19 27:10" (LXX) .†; (AS)

G4917.definition: συν-θλάω, -ῶ; to crush together, crush: Mat.21:44 (, R, mg., om.), Luk.20:18.†; (AS)

G4957.definition: συν-σταυρόω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, ; to crucify together with: pass., with dative, Jhn.19:32; id. before σύν, Mat.27:44, Mrk.15:32. Metaphorical, of the mystical death of the Christian with Christ: Rom.6:6, Gal.2:20 (Eccl.).†; (AS)

G4977.definition: to cleave, rend: Mat.27:51, Mrk.1:10 15:38, Luk.5:36 23:45, Jhn.19:24 21:11; metaphorically, in pass., to be divided into factions, Act.14:4 23:7.† ; (AS)

G4972.definition: to seal, ; (a) for security: Mat.27:66, Rev.20:3; τ. καρπὸν τοῦτον, figuratively (cf. Deiss., BS, 238 f.; MM, xxiv; DB, iv, 427a), Rom.15:28; (b) for concealment, hence, metaphorically, to hide (Da TH Dan.9:24, Jhn.14:17): Rev.10:4 22:10; (with) for distinction, Rev.7:3-8; metaphorically, Eph.4:30; mid., 2Co.1:22; (d) for authentication (Est.8:8): Jhn.3:33 6:27 (cf. κατα-σφραγίζω).†; (AS)

G4993.definition: (σώφρων), ; (a) to be of sound mind or in one's right mind: Mrk.5:15, Luk.8:35; opposite to ἐκστῆναι, 2Co.5:13 (Hdt.); (b) to be temperate, discreet, self-controlled (opposite to μαίνεσθαι, ὑβρίζειν, etc.; sch., Thuc., al.): Tit.2:6; opposite to ὑπερφρονεῖν, Rom.12:3; σ. καὶ νήφειν, 1Pe.4:7.†; (AS)

G4918.definition: συν-θλίβω; to press together, press on all sides: Mrk.5:24, 31.†; (AS)

G4936.definition: συν-τρέχω; to run together or with: before ἐκεῖ, Mrk.6:33; πρόσ, with accusative, Act.3:11; metaphorically, 1Pe.4:4.†; (AS)

G4949.definition: Συροφοινίκισσα (Rec. -φοίνισσα), -ης, ἡ ; a Syropænician woman: Mrk.7:26, WH, txt., RV (cf. ἡ Φοινίκη Συρία, Diod., 19, 93).†; (AS)

G4952.definition: συ-σπαράσσω ; to convulse completely: with accusative of person(s), Mrk.9:20, Luk.9:42 (cf. σπαράσσω).†; (AS)
renderings: threw the boy into a convulsion

G4907.definition: (συνίημι),  ; 1. a running or flowing together (Hom.). ; 2. (a) understanding: Luk.2:47, 1Co.1:19" (LXX), Eph.3:4, Col.1:9 2:2, 2Ti.2:7 ; (b) the understanding, the mind or intelligence: Mrk.12:33.†; SYN.: see: σοφία (AS)

G4931.definition: συν-τελέω, -ῶ; "perfective" of τελέω (cf. M, Pr., 118), ; 1. to complete, finish, bring to an end: Luk.4:13; pass., Luk.4:2, Jhn.2:3, WH, mg., Act.21:27. ; 2. to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment (cf. MM, xxiv): Mrk.13:4, Rom.9:28, Heb.8:8.†; (AS)

G4953.definition: σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό ; (σῆμα),  ; a fixed sign or signal: Mrk.14:44. (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 492 f.) †; (AS)

G4955.definition: στασιαστής; (στασιάζω, to stir up sedition, Jdth.7:15, 2Ma.4:30 2Mac 14:6 *) ; = Att.. στασιώτης, ; a rebel, revolutionist, one who stirs up sedition: Mrk.15:7 (FlJ, al.).†; συ-στασιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ, ; a fellow-rioter: Mrk.15:7, Rec.†; (AS)

G4903.definition: 1. prop., to work together (with): absol., Mrk.16:20, 1Co.16:16, 2Co.6:1; with dative, Jas.2:22; dative commod., Rom.8:28, T, R, txt. (but see infr.). ; 2. In Hellenistic writers (M, Pr., 65), trans., to cause to work together (cf. ICC, in l): with accusative of thing(s), Rom.8:28  R, mg. (but see supr.).†; (AS)

G4990.definition: (σώζω),  ; saviour, deliverer, preserver, a frequently epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE, 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT, ; (a) of God (as LXX: Psa.24:5, Isa.12:2, al.): Luk.1:47, 1Ti.1:1 2:3 4:10, Tit.1:3 2:10 3:4, Ju 25; (b) of Christ: Luk.2:11, Act.5:31 13:23, Php.3:20; τ. κόσμου, Jhn.4:42, 1Jn.4:14 (for the general use of the word, see Westc., in l); ἡμῶν, 2Ti.1:10, Tit.1:4 3:6…

G4991.definition: (σωτήρ),  ; deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety (Lat. salus): Act.7:25 27:34, Heb.11:7; ἐξ ἐχθρῶν, Luk.1:71. In NT esp. of Messianic and spiritual salvation (see: σώζω): Luk.19:9, Jhn.4:22, Act.4:12 13:47, Rom.11:11, 2Th.2:13, 2Ti.3:15, Heb.2:3 6:9, 2Pe.3:15, Ju 3; opposite to ἀπηώλεια, Php.1:28; αἰώνιος-., Heb.5:9; ὁ λόγος (τὸ εὐαγγέλιον) τῆς σ., Act.13:26, Eph.1:13; ὁδὸς σωτηρίας, Act.16:17; κέρας…

G4992.definition: σωτήριος, -ον; (σωτήρ),  ; saving, bringing salvation, in NT always in spiritual sense (see: σώζω, σωτηρία): ἡ χάρις ἡ σ., Tit.2:1. Neut., -τὸ σ., as subst. (cl.), salvation: Luk.2:30; τ. σ. τ. θεοῦ, Luk.3:6, Act.28:28; περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σ., Eph.6:17.†; (AS)

G4923.definition: 1. a journey in company (Plut., al.). ; 2. By meton., κ company of travellers, a caravan: Luk.2:44.†; (AS)

G4984.definition: (σῶμα),  ; (a) of or for the body, bodily: γυμνασία, 1Ti.4:8; (b) (opposite to ἀσώματος) bodily, corporeal: εἶδος, Luk.3:22.†; (AS)

G4948.definition: a Syrian: Luk.4:27, Mrk.7:26, WH, mg.† ; (AS)

G4940.definition: συν-τυγχάνω; to meet with, fall in with: with dative of person(s), Luk.8:19.†; (AS)

G4921.definition: συν-ίστημι; 1. trans., ; (a) to commend, recommend: with accusative of person(s), 2Co.3:1 6:4 10:12 10:18; id. with dative, Rom.16:1 (as frequently at the beginning of a letter; Deiss., LAE, 226), 2Co.5:12; before πρός, 2Co.4:2; pass., before ὑπό, 2Co.12:11; (b) to show, prove, establish: with accusative, Rom.3:5 5:8, 2Co.6:4; dupl. accusative, Gal.2:13; accusative and inf., 2Co.7:11 ; 2. Intrans., pf., συνέστηκα…

G4909.definition: συν-ευ-δοκέω, -ῶ; to join in approving, consent, agree to or with: absol., Act.22:20; with dative of person(s), Rom.1:32; with dative of thing(s), Luk.11:48, Act.8:1; with inf., 1Co.7:12-13 (chiefly in late writers).† ; (AS)

G4906.definition: συν-εσθίω; to eat with one: with dative of person(s), Luk.15:2, Act.10:41 11:3, 1Co.5:11; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), Gal.2:12.†; (AS)

G4928.definition: συν-οχή, -ῆς, ή; (συνέχω),  ; 1. a holding or being held together. ; 2. a narrow place (Hom., al.). Metaphorical, straits, distress: Luk.21:25; καρδίας, 2Co.2:4.†; (AS)

Mid., ; (a) to observe, perceive; (b) to determine, agree, covenant: with inf., Luk.22:5; before τοῦ, with inf., Act.23:20; before ἵνα, Jhn.9:22.†; συν-επι-τίθημι,; to help in putting on. Mid., to join in attacking (Thuc.): Act.24:9 (RV, joined in the charge).†; (AS)

G4979.definition: (dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), ; [in LXX chiefly for a rope (prop., one made of rushes): Jhn.2:15, Act.27:32.†; (AS)

G4965.definition: (Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ ; Sychar, a town of Samaria: Jhn.4:5.†; (AS)

G4914.definition: (ἦθος),  ; 1 1 intimacy. ; 2. habit, custom: Jhn.18:39, 1Co.11:16; with genitive obj. (cf. Æschin., 23, 37, and see MM, xxiv), habitual use, force of habit with respect to, 1Co.8:7.†; (AS)

G4951.definition: to draw, drag: with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.21:8, Rev.12:4; with accusative of person(s), of taking to trial or punish­ment, Act.8:3; ἔξω τ. πόλεως, Act.14:19; ἐπὶ τ. πολιτάρχας (cf. 4Mac, l.with), Act.17:6 (cf. κατα-ούρω).†; (AS)

G4974.definition: the ankle: Act.3:7, Rec. (T, WH, σφυδρόν; see Bl., § 6, 8).†; (AS)

G4966.definition: Shechem; 1. the son of Hamor (Gen.33:19): Act.7:16 b, Rec. ; 2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Act.7:16 a,b.†; (AS)

G4900.definition: συν-ελαύνω; to drive together, force together: εἰς εἰρήνην, Act.7:26, Rec. (WH, RV, συνήλλασσεν).†; (AS)

G4967.definition: (σφάζω),  ; slaughter: Act.8:32 (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rom.8:36 (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, Jas.5:5.†; (AS)

G4922.definition: συν-οδεύω; to journey with: with dative of person(s), Act.9:7 (Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G4926.definition: συν-ομιλέω, -ῶ ; to converse with (absol., FlJ, Bl, v, 13, 1; before μετά, Cebes, 13): with dative of person(s), Act.10:27.†; (AS)

G4975.definition: σχέδον; adv. (ἔχω),  ; 1. of place, near. ; 2. Of degree, almost, nearly: Act.13:44 19:26, Heb.9:22.†; (AS)

G4911.definition: συν-εφ-ίστημι ; to place over. Pass., ; 1. to stand over (Thuc.). ; 2. to rise together: before κατά, with genitive of person(s) (against), Act.16:22.†; (AS)

G4927.definition: συν-ομορέω, -ῶ ; to border on: with dative, Act.18:7 (Byz.).†; (AS)

G4988.definition: Sosthenes; (a) a Jewish ruler: Act.18:7; (b) a Christian: 1Co.1:1.†; (AS)

G4981.definition: 1. leisure. ; 2. Later (from Plato on), ; (a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture; (b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: Act.19:9 (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4963.definition: συ-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ; (συστρέφω),  ; 1. a twisting together (Plat.). ; 2. a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): Act.19:40; σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.with), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): Act.23:12.†; (AS)

G4902.definition: συν-έπομαι; to follow with, accompany: with dative of person(s), Act.20:4.†; (AS)

G4919.definition: συν-θρύπτω ; to break in pieces, crush: metaphorically, τ. καρδίαν, Act.21:13.†; (AS)

G4935.definition: συν-τόμως, ; adv. (συντέμνω)  ; concisely, briefly: Act.24:4 (for a similar ex., see MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4997.definition: (a) soundness of mind, good sense, sanity (opposite to μανία, Xen.): Act.26:25; (b) self-control, sobriety: 1Ti.2:9 (see Tr., Syn., § xx), 1Ti.2:15.†; (AS)

G4950.definition: Σύρτις (L, σῦρτις), -εως, accusative -ιν, ἡ, ; Syrtis, the name of two large sand-banks on the Libyan coast: Act.27:17.†; (AS)

G4946.definition: ionic Συρήκουσαι, doric Συράκοσαι, and Σῦράκοσσαι, Syracuse , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G4999.definition: ταβέρνη; (Lat. taberna), see: Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι. ; Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι ; (see: ταβέρνη), ; Three Taverns (Lit. Tres Tabernae) a halting place on the Appian Way: Act.28:15 (see DB, iv, 690).†; (AS)

G4938.definition: σύν-τριμμα, -τος, τό; (συντρίβω),  ; a fracture (Arist.; Le, l.with, al.). Metaphorical, calamity, destruction (Isa, l.with, Wis.3:3, al.): Rom.3:16" (LXX) .†; (AS)

G4973.definition: 1. a seal, signet: Rev.7:2. ; 2. The impression of a seal or signet, a seal (on its various purposes, see: σφραγίζω): on a book or roll, Rev.5:1-2, 5 5:9 6:1, 3 6:5, 7 6:9, 12 8:1; metaphorically, Rom.4:11, 1Co.9:2, 2Ti.2:19, Rev.9:4.†; (AS)

G4916.definition: συν-θάπτω ; to bury together with: in symbolical sense, of baptism, σὐτῷ (with Christ), Rom.6:4, Col.2:12.†; (AS)

G4913.definition: συν-ήδομαι ; to rejoice together; with dative, to rejoice with or in: τ. νόμῳ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.7:22 (see Lft., Notes, 304).†; (AS)

G4959.definition: συν-στενάζω (Rec. συσ-), ; to groan together or with: Rom.8:22 (with dative of person(s), Eur., Ion., 935).†; (AS)

G4944.definition: συν-ωδίνω ; to be in travail together (Arist.): metapb. (Eur.), Rom.8:22.†; (AS)

G4932.definition: συν-τέμνω; 1. to cut in pieces. ; 2. to cut down, cut short: metapb., λόγον, Rom.9:28 (LXX) (Hdt., Plat., Fur., al.).†; (AS)

G4964.definition: συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-), ; (σχῆμα), ; to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to: Rom.12:2, 1Pe.1:14.†; (AS)

G4987.definition: (a) to heap on: with accusative before ἐπί with accusative, Rom.12:20 (LXX) (Arist., al.); (b) to heap with: with accusative and dative, metaphorically, ἁμαρτίαις, 2Ti.3:6 (overwhelmed with, Field, Notes, 217) (Polyb.).†; (AS)

G4904.definition: a fellow-worker: with genitive of person(s), Rom.16:3, 9 16:21, Php.2:25 4:3, 1Th.3:2, Rec., Phm 1 24; θεοῦ (cf. Lft., Notes, 41, 188), 1Co.3:9 (pl.), 1Th.3:2  R, mg. (R, txt., διάκονον τοῦ θ.; on the original reading, see ICC, in l); τ. χαρᾶς ὑηῶν, 2Co.1:24; τ. ἀληθείᾳ, III Jn 8; before εἰς, 2Co.8:23, Col.4:11.†; (AS)

G4976.definition: (ἔχω),  ; figure, fashion: 1Co.7:31, Php.2:8.†; SYN.: see: μορφή (AS)

G4943.definition: συν-υπουργέω, -ῶ ; to help together, join in serving: with dative instr., 2Co.1:11.†; (AS)

G4956.definition: συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν ; (συνίστημι), ; 1. for putting together, constructive. ; 2. for bringing together, introductory, commendatory: ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and see MM, xxiv), 2Co.3:1.†; (AS)

G4915.definition: συν-ηλικιώτης; (ἡλικία), = συνῆλιζ (Æsch.), ; one of the same age, an equal in age: Gal.1:14.†; (AS)

G4942.definition: συν-υπο-κρίνομαι ; to play a part with, dissemble with: with dative, Gal.2:13 (Polyb.).†; (AS)

G4960.definition: συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, ; to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaphorical, to correspond to: Gal.4:25 (see Lft., in l).†; (AS)

G4925.definition: συν-οίκοδομέω, -ῶ; 1. to build together or with (with dative of person(s), 1Esdras, l.with). ; 2. Of various materials, to build up together (Thuc., al.): metaphorically, of Christians, Eph.2:22.†; (AS)

G4954.definition: σύν-σωμος (Rec. συσσ-), -ον ; (σῶμα), ; of the same body: Eph.3:6 (Eccl.).†; (AS)

G4961.definition: συν-στρατιώτης (Rec. συσ-), -ου, ὁ ; a fellow-soldier (Plat., Xen., al.). Metaphorical, of fellowship in Christian service: Php.2:25, Phm 2 .†; (AS)

G4985.definition: adv., ; bodily, corporeally: Col.2:9 (see ICC, Lft., in l).†; (AS)

G4998.definition: (a) of sound mind, sane, sensible; (b) self-controlled, sober-minded: 1Ti.3:2, Tit.1:8 2:2, 5 (Arist.).†; (AS)

G4995.definition: (σωφρονίζω), ; (a) an admonishing (F1J, Plut., al.); (b) self-control, self-discipline: 2Ti.1:7 (on the reflexive meaning here, see Ellic., in l).†; (AS)

G4994.definition: to make σώφρων, recall one to his senses, control (RV, train): with accusative of person(s), Tit.2:4.†; (AS)

G4996.definition: adv.,  ; with sound mind, prudently, soberly: Tit.2:12.†; (AS)

G4901.definition: συν-επι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ ; to join in attesting, bear witness together with: Heb.2:4 (Arist., Polyb., a1.).†; (AS)

G4924.definition: συν-οικέω, -ῶ; to dwell together: of man and wife (Hdt., al.), with dative of person(s), 1Pe.3:7,†; (AS)

G4910.definition: συν-ευωχέω, -ῶ ; to entertain together. Pass., to fare sumptuously or feast together or with: Ju 12; with dative of person(s), 2Pe.2:13 (Arist., Luc., al.).†; (AS)

G4969.definition: to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, Rev.5:6, 12 13:8; of persons, 1Jn.3:12, Rev.5:9 6:4, 9 18:24; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), Rev.13:3 (cf. κατα-σφάζω).†; (AS)
